recommenderAllocation: Alternate SASRec and GRU4Rec using the frozen task order and seed assignment.

checks.evaluationMode: Every selected model must report training=false before scoring.
checks.withinProcess: Three uncached score calls for the same context must be byte-identical.
checks.freshProcess: The canonical 32-task Top-10 shelf-state SHA-256 must match the preceding completed preflight from a fresh process.

decisionRule: Pass only when all 32 tasks pass evaluation-mode and within-process checks and the fresh-process shelf hash matches.
privacy: Public output contains counts and aggregate hashes only; no item IDs, task IDs, titles, reviews, or model score vectors.
